title: Holy priest: Defensive Arms warrior with .bot role self tank gets no shield above critical

rules.desc: With the player's forced role set to tank the holy priest casts no Power Word: Shield on him above the critical band
rules.source: ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:4009 (stored forced role first); commands/Party.cpp:867 (.bot role self); ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/PriestActions.h:42; issue #1553
rules.why_expect: the stored forced role is read before talents or stance, so the guard applies

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight, so the shield rule above is about this stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); setup check player_stance proves it at the start, this proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the runner re-casts the stance and excludes time without it
